svg.title: Vela Omni Nano: three embedding encoders
svg.desc: Bottom-to-top public encode_text, encode_image and encode_audio graphs. Expanded Transformer layers show real normalization order, residuals, attention and feed-forward widths. The common vector space contains three independently computed vectors. Dropout, inactive during inference, is omitted. Nano vision uses learned-probe attention pooling followed by a pre-normalized GELU-tanh residual MLP. The frozen GIST-small text tower has twelve BERT layers and uses CLS readout with identity projection. The single-modality package has no BERT pooler, multimodal fusion, or intermediate exit heads.
